status: Fifth window for the adaptive-alarm confirmation (adaptive_alert_protocol.json). All model, history, identity and threshold settings copied unchanged from transaction_fresh_protocol.json; only dates and sources differ. Dates never used before in the project.
primary: Context versus payer-plus-structural-plus-readonly/template HGB on cold fee payers: AP improvement with 500 paired one-hour block bootstrap draws. Global and cold FPR/recall are secondary and must be disclosed.
confirmation: Additional unused-date evaluation; retain results regardless of direction.
sample: First row group of alternate date/seed hash-ranked shard, selected using file counts without outcomes. Not complete or verified random sample.
cleaning: Identical signature/selected-payload duplicates counted once; any conflicting duplicate or timestamp/partition mismatch aborts. Rule added after input audit found 15 repeated rows, before any models fit.
features: Declared account identities/roles and counts, plus labeled participation from blocks at least one hour earlier. No current logs, status, error, actual compute use, balances, fee paid, inclusion slot/index or timestamp as model input.
task: Retrospective execution-risk screening conditional on eventual block inclusion. Declared account lists presumed resolvable before execution; actual submission times and unlanded attempts absent, so not a live pre-submission performance claim.
cold_payer: First declared signer has never occurred as first signer in sampled history whose outcome is available. Does not establish a new operator.
novelty_hypothesis: Role-separated non-payer participation history may transfer execution-risk signal to unseen fee payers. Historical-risk aggregation is established; a new algorithm is not claimed. Need empirical success and differentiation from adjacent research.
refined_primary: First declared signer appearance in the sampled replay, context_identity_hgb versus readonly_identity_hgb AP with paired hour bootstrap. Primary-context comparison and cold-history results also retained. Success requires positive AP gain and interval entirely above zero; does not establish a new algorithm.
calibration_followup: Isotonic on cold validation first12hours; threshold on remaining purged cold validation at5%FPR; compare original/followup cold FPR, recall, Brier and AP. No test-driven choice.
